name: AZELIS (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED
india_angle: Azelis supports a wide range of industries in India with advanced materials and local application labs.
summary: Azelis is a global innovation service provider specializing in specialty chemicals, offering tailored solutions for the semiconductor industry. They provide key technologies such as soldering materials, high-purity anodes, and ultra-high purity MBE materials, supporting advanced packaging and surface finishing applications.
